name: Dispute Resolution Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the disputed collateral amount.

RECO.name: Reconcile Collateral
RECO.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the collateral.

REEX.name: Reconcile Exposure
REEX.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the exposure.

RETH.name: Reconcile Threshold
RETH.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the threshold.

RMTA.name: Reconcile Minimum Transfer Amount
RMTA.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the minimum transfer amount.

RERO.name: Reconcile Rounding
RERO.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the rounding.

REVF.name: Reconcile Valuation Frequency
REVF.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the valuation frequency.

RNIA.name: Reconcile Netted Independent Amount
RNIA.definition: Indicates that the disputed collateral amount should be confirmed through reconciliation of the independent amount.
